contact_edits.before: The story holds you. It just doesn't seem as significant as everyone thinks it is. Nixon's capitulation may have been cathartic for him but it can't have told Americans anything they didn't already know. It made no difference, except to David Frost's career which is only important if you're David Frost. And the stakes seem grotesquely disproportionate: a man jeopardizing his job against one who cashiered his country. The real drama was in Watergate itself. The interviews weren't even an epilogue: just a belated sideshow. - Frost/Nixon runs until Nov. 8. For tickets and information call 416-368-3110.
